name: Slumbering Tora — becomes an X/X Cat artifact creature, X = the discarded card's mana value, entered on the ability
notes: Sweep group 4 (2026-10-07). A number read off a card that is not on the battlefield is asked for as X on the fired ability (the "where X is …" clause is cut from the fired text and the ability gets an X input, saved with the board). "This artifact becomes an X/X Cat artifact creature until end of turn, where X is the discarded card's mana value." gave the types but no power or toughness. X = 5: a 5/5 Cat artifact creature.
